privacyPage.meta_description: Privacy information for the questionnaire for self-reflection at map.synapticfour.com.
privacyPage.intro: This notice describes processing of personal data when you use the questionnaire at map.synapticfour.com, in line with Art. 13 GDPR. The controller is Synaptic Four (Stuttgart). The questionnaire is a tool for self-reflection.
privacyPage.controller_body: Synaptic Four, Stuttgart, Ujerumani. Barua pepe: contact@synapticfour.com. Anwani kamili na maelezo ya kisheria: https://synapticfour.com/en/impressum (Kiingereza) au https://synapticfour.com/de/impressum (Kijerumani).
privacyPage.data_body: The purpose is to show you your own result and, if you consent, to save that result so you can open it again later or on another device. The data are your answers, response times, a session identifier, timestamps, and the derived profile. The questionnaire does not ask for your name, email, or postal address. If you email us, that message is a separate activity.
privacyPage.legal_basis_body: Saving is based on your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) GDPR. Because answers about how you think may concern health, that consent also covers Art. 9(2)(a) GDPR. The save choice is not pre-ticked and is separate from the confirmation that you have read a section. Withdrawing consent deletes the saved answers.
privacyPage.hosting_body: Programu ya wavuti inawekwa na Vercel Inc. (Marekani) kama jukwaa la uwekaji / edge. Unapofungua tovuti, data muhimu kiufundi huchakatwa (kwa mfano anwani ya IP, muda, rasilimali iliyoombwa), kama ilivyo kawaida kwa uendeshaji wa tovuti.
privacyPage.transfers_body: Kwa kuwa Vercel iko Marekani, data inaweza kuhamishwa nchi ya tatu. Uhamisho huo unategemea Masharti ya Kawaida ya Mkataba wa EU na/au dhamana nyingine chini ya Kifungu cha 46 cha GDPR na, inapofaa, hatua za ziada. Tazama nyaraka za Vercel kwa masharti ya sasa.
privacyPage.storage_body_supabase: If you consent, the answers are stored with Supabase, in the EU region configured for this project. Only the SHA-256 hash of the restore secret is stored. Whoever has the restore link can open the answers. The anonymous API key cannot read session rows. The server route that opens or deletes a session uses the service role, which stays in the server environment.
privacyPage.storage_body_local: Bila muunganisho wa Supabase uliosanidiwa, data hubaki tu kwenye kifaa chako (kwa mfano localStorage ya kivinjari na precache nje ya mtandao).
privacyPage.storage_verification_note: Waendeshaji wanapaswa kuthibitisha mara kwa mara eneo la mradi, nakala rudufu, na uigaji kwenye dashibodi ya Supabase na kusasisha ilani hii ikiwa usanidi utabadilika.
privacyPage.local_storage_heading: Uhifadhi wa ndani wa kivinjari (matumizi ya kazi)
privacyPage.local_storage_body: Data huhifadhiwa kwenye kivinjari kwa utendaji msingi (kipindi, lugha, matumizi nje ya mtandao). Hatutumii vidakuzi vya matangazo au uchambuzi wa masoko. Idhini baada ya taarifa hii inashughulikia uchakataji pale idhini inapohitajika; uhifadhi wa kiufundi unaohitajika kabisa unaweza kuwa na msingi tofauti.
privacyPage.retention_body: Saved answers are kept until you delete them, or for 12 months after saving, whichever comes first. A daily scheduled deletion removes sessions whose retention time has passed. Until you save, the answers stay in this browser.
privacyPage.deletion_before_link: You can delete every saved row of your session with the same restore secret, from the results page or by opening the restore link. Local data in this browser are cleared as well:
privacyPage.withdrawal_body: Withdrawing consent deletes the saved answers. Use the delete control on the results page with your restore secret, or write to contact@synapticfour.com. Withdrawal does not change the lawfulness of processing before the deletion.
privacyPage.sharing_body: Recipients of saved answers: Supabase, in the EU region configured for this project. The website is hosted by Vercel. Answers are not sold and are not used for research.
privacyPage.rights_body: You can ask for access, rectification, erasure, restriction, and a copy of your answers (Arts. 15, 16, 17, 18 and 20 GDPR), and you can lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority. The restore link is how you open your own saved answers. Contact: contact@synapticfour.com.
privacyPage.automated_body: Hatufanyi maamuzi yanayotegemea kikamilifu uchakataji wa kiotomatiki kwa maana ya Kifungu cha 22 cha GDPR yanayotoa athari za kisheria au athari za kiasi kulinganisha kulingana na matumizi yako ya PCMS.
privacyPage.disclaimer_body: This is a questionnaire for self-reflection. It does not diagnose and it is not a study. It is not a medical device. For health concerns, speak with a qualified professional.
privacyPage.supervisory_body: Una haki ya kuwasilisha malalamiko kwa mamlaka ya usimamizi (Kifungu cha 77 cha GDPR). Kwa Synaptic Four Stuttgart, Kamishna wa Baden-Württemberg wa Ulinzi wa Data na Uhuru wa Habari anaweza kuwa mwenye uwezo: https://www.baden-wuerttemberg.datenschutz.de/
privacyPage.contact_body: Maswali kuhusu uchakataji au kutumia haki zako: contact@synapticfour.com.
privacyPage.not_legal_advice: Maandishi haya si ushauri wa kisheria na hayachukui nafasi ya ushauri kwa hali yako maalum.
